programs.title: The Outlaws
programs.desc: The outlaws’ illicit business begins to run like a well-oiled machine. When Gabby engages in some spirited activism of her own, Myrna displaces her occupational guilt by using her talent for community engagement. John finds the job market isn’t what it was. Christian’s old enemy receives an inquisitive visitor and, later, a painful message. A familiar (and obnoxious) face jeopardises the group’s progress, placing them firmly in the crosshairs of Bristol and Avon Constabulary. As Christian looks to the future, he suspects Rani might be more into their dangerous new lifestyle than he is - until she comes through with an unexpected source of support.
